items.note: S5.1-S5.2 state the lemma (y_S -> y_S+x_S for arbitrary scratch; three stages give (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) and restore scratch), and S5.1.1-S5.1.4 follow the proof at 741-765: net change (JV+RG)x, central coefficient |S∩T| mod 2 or (|S∩T|-1)/2, side cancellation, then the composition (x,y+x),(-y,y+x),(-y,x). The neighbour rules are only implied, and the neighbour counts and wire counts W_b, W_c (767-782) are never given.

The plan gives the invariant 'stored = frame applied to logical array' (method), commutation of a shared frame with a linear pointwise gate (S5.3.1), the operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1} (S5.3.2) and the route operator eps_w D_sink(rho(w)) D_source(w)^{-1} including auxiliary roles (S5.3.3). This is exactly the argument at 804-825.

The conclusions are stated correctly: triple lines nondegenerate and orthogonal, F^{⊗3} of dimension m, sources N and sinks Wm-N, comparable labels, the only losses on centre 3->4 of h each, L=Ich, sum Wm-2N+2L, and ratios 100/539 and 101/539. But the labels themselves (terminal table 881-889, stage transitions 911-937, gate-label table eq:motif-labels, residual table 1021-1043) are never constructed, so the nesting claims are asserted rather than derived. The lemma's F_2 orthonormal-basis clause (1073-1102), which the complex interface needs, is also absent.

The rank sum s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m is derived faithfully: rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U, and the N edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one. The endpoint identity M_sink(rho(w))-M_source(w)=I_m appears only as the contract condition invoked in S5.9.3. Its verification P_{U_a^perp}-(-P_{U_a})=I_m (1169-1171), which is why the negative source projection exists, is not shown.

The plan follows the proof: weight additivity modulo 4 for orthogonal vectors gives q_V-q_U; odd weight turns each phase into aI+bX_v or its inverse after H^{⊗m}; one kernel per residual vector gives s_c=W_c m-2N+2L_c with deficit 2N-2L_c; telescoping gives C^{⊗m}, and C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates of X_a->Y_a is fixed by C=iZC^{-1}Z. The explicit frame formula and the k-column tensoring are only described loosely.

L/N<1/2 gives deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0. The exact eta_b and eta_c both exceed 20*2^{-50}. With log m<20, m^{1-2^{-50}}>m(1-20*2^{-50})>m(1-eta), so s/W<m^tau with tau=sigma=1-2^{-50}. This matches 1319-1346.

S3 lists the elementary O(V) operations: digit permutation, digit move, split/apply/merge, and cyclic row split into W streams. S4 states the controlled shift and unit scaling with the split-and-remerge idea. Both are infer steps without sub-steps. S4's claim leaves the b^{O(1)} offset-preparation condition to its quoted line 566.

The shear part follows 1425-1447 exactly: triangular factors as descending-order controlled shifts, the E_2/E_1^{-1}, Pi, E_1/E_2^{-1} sequence, one interchange per one of Pi via D+=H, swap, D=H-D, and a recursive calls = rank. But the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 (S5.7) is only quoted, with no elimination proof (1375-1392). The choice of the odd prime q avoiding all denominators and diagonal numerators (1413-1423) is also omitted.

Every element of 1491-1616 is present: cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W with rows divisible by W^{k-1}, edge shears Phi_{A_e} by recursive pivot interchanges, frame identity plus endpoint condition giving H<-H+D on every role, the three-update interchange, s calls, the recurrence F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) solved in both cases a<=1 and a>1, the depth-first fixed-tape schedule, and descriptor absorption.

The plan follows the proof step by step: rho high digits form a row field R=q^{2rho}>=W^k, padded to R'<2R; a base-m expansion of e-rho gives power-width pieces costing O(V) sum a_j m^{j tau}=O(Ve^tau); undoing costs O(V log 2e); binary ranges are padded to [q^e] with volume factor <q^2 and e=O(u).

Present: the edge identity P_M(prod C_{e_j}^{eps_j})P_M^{-1} with the residual basis as the first columns of M, one child per basis vector on a slot of f axes, inverse children via (C^{-1})^{⊗f}=(-i)^f Z C Z, Gaussian elimination into at most m(m-1)+3m row additions, s_c child calls giving C^{⊗e} on every role, and H_0^{⊗D}=b^D S_D C^{⊗D} S_D with b^D a shift and phase. The conjugation rule P_M X_v P_M^{-1}=X_{Mv} is implicit.

Present: the eight parity-conditioned updates composing to (00 10)(01 11), the guard interval 10<=g<=2^{K-1}-11, the union bound to delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0 S_0^{-1} permuting B, at most 16 swaps and 8 rotations, the radix-sort repair, the three cost terms, the family simplification, and the application to basis changes at O(V((eK)^tau+1)). The temporary omission of j_{f-1}, handled by a final two-bit XOR, is not mentioned.

errors.says: Along every side wire the successive labels are nested, because t_X ⊥ t_Y gives <t_X> ⊂ t_Y^perp.
errors.paper: Orthogonality of neighbouring triple lines is used for one inclusion only: the side edge 2->5, P⊗<t_X> ⊂ P⊗t_Y^perp. The other side-wire nestings come from splitting A=B⊥P and F=<t>⊥t^perp, not from t_X ⊥ t_Y.

errors.says: H_0 is applied to the selected bit in each of d address chunks ... in O(Vd^{lambda'}) time.
errors.paper: The proposition covers any 1<=D<=d chunks of K=floor(d^c) bits; the transform rounds use it with D=d-1 or fewer participating axes.

chain: The tree follows the paper's route to the main bound: radix-digit convolution; two fast tape procedures built from fixed networks with s<Wm (bit shears to O(Vu^tau) interchange; phase frames to O(Vd^{lambda'}) layers); synthetic transforms and convolution; resampling with retained permutations and chirp cancellation; then parameters, the CRT map, exact recovery and the cost table with min margin 2kappa. It thins out at the base of the central construction: the network's parameters (h=100, triple-indexed banks, N, m=h^3, W) are never defined, the labels are asserted rather than constructed, the bit endpoint identity is invoked but not verified, and the triangular factorization is only quoted. The parameter step omits the numerical values of lambda, c, lambda' and delta, and the layer-condition checks.

steps.note: S5.2 states the bank exchange (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with all scratch restored, and S5.1 the triple-indexed gadget. But h=100, the indexing of data pairs by a∈T^3, N=binom(h,3)^3 and m=h^3 never appear; N and m are used without definition. Conservatively, the step's defining parameters are missing.
Common frame per gate commuting with the pointwise linear gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the explicit motivation that only edge changes cost anything.

Labels are nondegenerate subspaces of F^{⊗3} of dimension m; every edge joins comparable labels; the only decreasing edges are the centre wires from time 3 to 4, each losing P⊗F of dimension h. The concrete labels are not given, but the defining claims are.
rank(P_V-P_U)=dim V-dim U for nested nondegenerate labels, and the N source edges 2P_{U_a} of rank one with zero dimension change are the exceptions.
The signed changes telescope to Wm-2N, L=Ich, the absolute sum is Wm-2N+2L, and adding N source ranks gives s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b.
L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 are both below 1/2, giving deficits N-2L_b>0 and 2N-2L_c>0, hence s<Wm.
S5.9.3 states M_out(rho(w))-M_in(w)=I_m and that every role, scratch included, receives H<-H+D. The check P_{U_a^perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m is not shown, but the identity and its role in the chain are there.
A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones; the shear costs exactly a interchanges plus O(V), each interchange being a recursive call; a node therefore makes s recursive calls in all.
Children have volume V/W; F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1) is solved to F_k=O(e^tau); s/W<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} comes from eta>20*2^{-50} and log m<20.

central.summary: The plan reconstructs the central saving from frames through labels, rank = dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict deficit from L/N<1/2, the endpoint shear, edges as recursive calls, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50} (C2-C9). The weak point is C1: the fixed network appears only through its bank-exchange property, without h=100, the triple-indexed banks, N=binom(h,3)^3 or m=h^3, so the quantities in s<Wm are never anchored.
